title: Chinese Dragon & Phoenix Rock Sculpture, 1950s Haw Par Villa Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot capturing a dramatic, large-scale Chinese mythological relief sculpted directly into an artificial rock wall. The tableau depicts intricate dragons winding around rocky crags and an elaborate phoenix (fenghuang) standing centered upon clouds above a traditional tiled roofline. Typical of the whimsical folk-art style found in the mid-20th-century Tiger Balm Gardens (Haw Par Villa).
